messages:
Asha (CS): Quick capture from today's onboarding calls — saw the same three asks across 4 customers, filing here for product prioritization and enablement.
Asha (CS): 1) Per-route cost breakdown in Console (customers want to see token spend per endpoint, not just account-level). 2) Better UX for re-issuing API keys during rotate (confusing for admins). 3) A lighter-weight quickstart sample that shows embeddings -> similarity search, but with a realtime UI sample.
Maya (SE): +1 on per-route cost. We had a support ticket where customer misattributed cost to model choice; if we show route-level token counts and cost, it would avoid churn.
Luca (CSE): For key rotate UX — we also hit this with a security-conscious customer who needs zero-downtime rotate. They requested a preview mode that validates perms before rotate.
Jordi (PM): Thanks — this is helpful. Propose we triage with a simple priority rubric: impact (CS signals + revenue risk), engineering effort (T-shirt), and enablement ROI. Quick score will help sprint slotting.
Asha (CS): Draft scores from my side:
- Per-route cost: impact=H, effort=M
- Key rotate preview: impact=M, effort=S
- Quickstart UI: impact=M, effort=M

Asha (CS): I'll paste a minimal ticket template to use if we want to push to backlog.

Asha (CS): ```
Summary: Per-route cost visibility in Console
Description: Customers request per-route token and cost breakdown to identify hotspots and optimize usage. Suggested UI: route list with token counts, 7/30/90d filters, and export CSV. Business case: reduces billing confusion and support load; likely to reduce churn for high-usage pilots.
Acceptance criteria:
- Console shows per-route token counts and estimated cost (USD) for selected window
- Export option for CSV
- Docs/tooltip explaining calculation
Priority: ___
```

Jordi (PM): Nice template. Can you attach the top 2 support tickets numbers and any quotes in the ticket? That helps prioritization.

Asha (CS): Added ticket refs: #7891, #7924 and customer quote: "We can't see why our costs spiked — the rollout was to many endpoints, not one model."

Maya (SE): Engineering notes: for per-route cost we can surface already-collected token logs, need a small aggregation job and a Console UI. ETA ~2-3 sprints for M feature, but we can do a minimal beta (CSV export only) in 1 sprint.

Jordi (PM): OK — plan: create epic, backlog as beta export first sprint, full UI second sprint. @Maya can you add a one-paragraph technical approach in the ticket? @Luca can you prepare a short enablement doc for CS to use for pilots?

Luca (CSE): Will do — short guide + screenshots. Also will prepare a script we can run with customers to validate numbers.

Asha (CS): One more ask: can we add a flag to surface routes with >X tokens/day in Console? That was requested a few times.

Maya (SE): That can be a follow-up alerting feature (low effort). I'll note it under the epic as "route threshold alert".

Jordi (PM): Great. I'll create the epic and link the three tickets. Plan: beta CSV export to next sprint triage. Assigning to @Maya for tech spec and @Luca for enablement. Thanks all :raised_hands:
